manifest.catalogueName: The Tower v28.1.0 Project-wide Useful Data Map
manifest.purpose: Prioritised roadmap of APK/XAPK data areas useful for TBI.

categories.label: Enemy catalogue, death causes, and threat explanations
categories.confidence: High for names/descriptions; Medium for threat tags; Low for exact scaling.
categories.recommendation: Add enemyCatalogue v28.1.0 with official descriptions and TBI threat tags.

categories.label: Ultimate Weapons and upgrade families
categories.confidence: High for names/descriptions; Medium for linking stats; Low for exact cooldown/quantity values.
categories.recommendation: Add ultimateWeaponCatalogue with effects and linked Battle Report fields.

categories.label: Cards, card effects, and card masteries
categories.confidence: High for names/descriptions; Medium for strategic interpretation.
categories.recommendation: Add cardCatalogue + masteryCatalogue; useful before advanced coaching.

categories.label: Workshop upgrades and enhancements
categories.confidence: High for labels/descriptions; Low for exact upgrade cost formulas unless extracted later.
categories.recommendation: Build a workshopCatalogue with official labels/descriptions and families Attack/Defense/Utility/Economy.

categories.label: Labs / research catalogue
categories.confidence: High for category names and labels; Low for full formula/cost tables.
categories.recommendation: Add labResearchCatalogue with category/source labels; do not estimate lab costs yet.

categories.label: Tournament, Heat, leagues, battle conditions
categories.confidence: High for condition names/descriptions and heat breakpoints; Medium/Low for current live rotations.
categories.recommendation: Add heat/league catalogue, but keep live tournament settings source-labelled unless pasted by user or confirmed.

categories.label: Guardian and loot/shard tracking
categories.confidence: High for report fields; Medium for coaching meaning.
categories.recommendation: Add guardianCatalogue and a Guardian report section. This is very useful because current TBI likely under-explains it.

categories.label: Modules, rarities, substats, merge/shatter/reroll
categories.confidence: Medium-High for names/resources; Low for full unique effect tables without deeper extraction.
categories.recommendation: Add moduleCatalogue and moduleResourceCatalogue; keep effects descriptive first.

categories.label: Bots and bot upgrades
categories.confidence: High for names/labels; Medium for exact effect interpretation.
categories.recommendation: Add botCatalogue with known bot names/effects and Battle Report fields.

categories.label: Perks and trade-off perks
categories.confidence: High for text; Medium/Low for actual run state unless user records it.
categories.recommendation: Add perkGlossary and optional manual run tags; pasted Battle Reports may not include active perk state.
tbiUse: Command Deck explanation of weird run changes

categories.label: Resources and economy sources
categories.confidence: High for labels; Medium for causal interpretation.
categories.recommendation: Add resourceGlossary and economySourceMap linking Battle Report fields to source systems.

categories.label: Missions, events, relics, medals
categories.confidence: High for labels; Low for live event state.
categories.recommendation: Useful later, not first priority for Battle Report intelligence.

categories.label: Internal names useful for diagnostics only
categories.confidence: Medium. Useful for diagnostics, not player-facing wording.
categories.recommendation: Use internally only; do not expose ugly dev names in normal UI.

categories.label: Official UI strings and aliases
categories.confidence: High for wording; not gameplay logic.
categories.recommendation: Use as a parser/search dictionary, not as strategy data.

categories.label: Battle Report schema / parser dictionary
categories.confidence: High for labels/schema names; Medium for exact meaning of fallback buckets such as Other.

safetyScope: Static, read-only extraction of readable strings/metadata. No server access, bypassing, cheating, or app modification.
